info.title: Greek Developer - Notify CLI
info.description: Send notifications to multiple destinations (gotify, Discord)

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: notify: send a notification to one or more destinations. Non-interactive, so an agent can drive it.

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send a notification to the configured destinations

options.name: --title
options.description: Notification title. Falls back to the target's defaultTitle, then to none.

options.name: --priority
options.description: Priority (gotify: integer 0-10). Falls back to extras.priority, then 5.

options.name: --urls
options.description: Links to include in the message. Repeatable; several per token.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Profile to send to. Default 'default'. '*' means every target.

options.name: --target
options.description: Send to these named targets, ignoring profiles. Repeatable. Mutually exclusive with --profile.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress per-target 'ok' lines. Failures are still reported. [default: False]

arguments.name: MESSAGE
arguments.description: The notification body. Use '-' to read the body from stdin.

commands.name: path
commands.description: Print the resolved config file path.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the version, commit and build time of this build.

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Print this tool's agent guide, ready to save as a skill file.
